usage: Monochrome brand symbols in an explicitly illustrative customer roster and integration ecosystem.

connectors.usage: One logo per tool in the home-page integrations directory (src/home/connectors.data.ts), served from the repo, never hotlinked.
sources: Each app's own published brand mark, downloaded once and sanitised (SVG as-is; raster marks resized to 64px WebP).
Simple Icons 13.21.0 (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@13.21.0/icons/) where the app's own mark was unavailable.
The app's own site favicon or touch icon as the last fallback.
